issue.title: pii: a masking request in a synctest bubble would leave srv.stop and the idle timer tied to it, and the next Stop outside it crashes
issue.body:
Came up in the review of #3690. pii's `srv` is package-level, and two of its fields are made by whoever gets there first: `stopCh()` makes `srv.stop` on classifyTurn's first look and keeps it until Stop, and `idleLocked` makes `srv.idle` after each answered request. If a test ever runs a masking request inside a synctest bubble, both belong to that bubble, and the next `Stop()` outside it, or the next answered request, touching them is a fatal error that takes the test binary down.

Nothing hits it today: pii and masking have no synctest tests, and gateway's bubbles (TestConcurrentClassification*) never reach masking. A probe on 27ca0bef, `stopCh()` in a bubble and then `Stop()` outside it:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble
	internal/pii/serve.go:245
```

and `idleLocked` in a bubble, then `detachLocked` outside it (what Stop does):

```
fatal error: stop of synctest timer from outside bubble
	internal/pii/serve.go:270
```

Same family as #3632 and #3690. I'm leaving it out of the #3690 patch since it's another package, so it's here for whoever first puts pii or masking in a bubble.

comments.body:
pii's `srv` kept two fields made by whoever got there first, and a test's request in a synctest bubble owned both: `srv.stop` (made by `stopCh` on the first request, closed by `Stop`) and `srv.idle` (armed by each answered request, stopped by `detachLocked`). The next `Stop` outside that bubble was fatal, and took the whole pii test binary down with it — "close of synctest channel from outside bubble" and "stop of synctest timer from outside bubble", the two probes in the report.

The branch removes both leftovers:

- `Stop` counts itself in `srv.stopGen`, which a request takes when it gets its turn and compares after a load: a `Stop` since ends what that request was doing. So that a load under way still gives up at once, `Stop` ends the loading pf-serve itself — `startOne` leaves it in `srv.starting` while it loads, under the same lock that sees `stopGen` move — and the stop channel is gone with its wait.
- The idle timer is not kept at all any more: each answered request arms its own, and one whose pf-serve has been taken, or which a later answer made stale, finds another helper or `srv.idleGen` moved on and ends nothing. `detachLocked` stops nothing.
- AstrLink Guard had the same pair one function over — `guardIdle`/`guardUnload` stopping `gsrv.idle` from outside the bubble a request armed it in. `guardIdle` now takes the generation it was armed with and unloads nothing once a later answer or an unload moved it on.

[fix/3722-pii-a-masking-request-in](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3722-pii-a-masking-request-in), commit 1a81f400891748f79f7355a9ed913c5ee2680a1c

What was run (go1.26.8 toolchain, linux/amd64). Each red was taken with only `internal/pii`'s two product files reverted to the base and the test kept:

| Run | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `TestStopAfterARequestInABubbleClosesNothing` (the request path with no pf-serve on disk) | red: `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble`, `Stop` at serve.go:387; green now |
| `TestStopAfterAnAnsweredRequestInABubbleStopsNoTimer` (an answered request's idle timer in a bubble, then `Stop` outside) | red: `fatal error: stop of synctest timer from outside bubble`, `detachLocked` at serve.go:412; green now |
| `TestGuardStopAfterARequestInABubbleStopsNoTimer` (a guard request in a bubble, then `guardModel.Stop` outside) | red: the same fatal at `guardUnload`, astrlink.go:244; green now |
| `gofmt -l internal/pii`, `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/pii/`, `GOOS=linux -tags nogui` / `darwin` / `windows` vet | clean |
| `go test ./internal/pii/ -count=1` | ok, 59 tests; the same under `-race`, ok, 59 |
| `go test ./internal/masking/ ./internal/redact/ -count=1` | ok, 99 tests |

`go test -tags nogui ./...` was not taken to the end: `internal/provider` is red on main itself from #3632, and nothing outside `internal/pii`, masking and redact reaches this code.

One thing deliberately left alone, and why: a helper itself (`srv.h`) still ends through `h.exited`, a channel. A bubble cannot leave one behind — `synctest.Test` does not return while the goroutine `cmd.Wait` started in it is alive — so nothing outside a bubble waits on a channel one made.

Fork branch, ready to review; no claim on the issue's ownership.
